title: min_instances=0 breaks existing pinned unit test test_concurrency.py::test_min_instances; diff ships no test update
evidence:
tests/unit/test_concurrency.py:38-43:
    def test_min_instances(self) -> None:
        # min_instances = 1 keeps one warm instance so Gleam's
        # `session_create` POST never lands on a cold start. Bumped 0→1 in
        # commit 9816019 after staging cold-start failures on 2026-05-04.
        prod_tfvars = PRODUCTION_TFVARS.read_text()
        assert _extract_literal_int(prod_tfvars, "min_instances") == 1

deployment/terraform/vars/production.tfvars (post-diff):
min_instances = 0

Verified by running: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_concurrency.py -q → "FAILED tests/unit/test_concurrency.py::TestProductionTfvarsScaling::test_min_instances … assert 0 == 1" — 1 failed, 7 passed.
detail: The diff changes a value pinned by an existing unit test without updating it: the unit suite is red at the reviewed state. Also violates the repo's no-tech-debt rule; next PR touching tests/ fails confusingly.
recommended_fix: Update test_min_instances to assert == 0 and replace its stale warm-instance comment with the scale-to-zero rationale plus flip-back tripwire, mirroring the production.tfvars comment.

title: cpu_idle flipped to true in prod tfvars has zero test coverage (unpinned, unlike every other sizing var)
evidence:
TestProductionTfvarsScaling pins cpu/memory/min/max only (tests/unit/test_concurrency.py:45-52):
    def test_max_instances(self) -> None:
        prod_tfvars = PRODUCTION_TFVARS.read_text()
        assert _extract_literal_int(prod_tfvars, "max_instances") == 20

    def test_resources(self) -> None:
        prod_tfvars = PRODUCTION_TFVARS.read_text()
        assert _extract_literal_str(prod_tfvars, "cpu") == "2"
        assert _extract_literal_str(prod_tfvars, "memory") == "4Gi"

No test file references cpu_idle (grep over tests/ returns only terraform/service.tf:32 'cpu_idle = var.cpu_idle'). production.tfvars now: cpu_idle      = true
detail: The diff's second behavior change (request-based billing / idle CPU throttling) is untested. Every other prod sizing value is pinned structurally; cpu_idle drift would go unnoticed, including the planned tripwire flip-back.
recommended_fix: Add test_cpu_idle asserting prod cpu_idle == true alongside the existing sizing pins, citing the tripwire rationale, so any flip-back is a deliberate test change.

title: CI paths filters exclude deployment/terraform/** — this PR runs no tests and no terraform fmt/validate/plan automation exists
evidence:
.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:8-16:
    paths:
      - "tenant_scorer/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - "pyproject.toml"
(deployment/** absent; deploy-to-prod.yml:8-10 has the same filter). Makefile:107-108:
# Terraform — see deployment/README.md. CI only pushes the container image;
# config changes require a manual `terraform apply`.
detail: A terraform-only PR triggers zero CI: the broken pinned test above never runs, and acceptance's fmt/validate checks are manual-only. Both changed values reach prod with no automated verification.
recommended_fix: Add deployment/terraform/** to pr-checks.yml paths so structural unit pins run on infra PRs; add a terraform fmt -check + validate step (init -backend=false).

title: New comment embeds 'min_instances = 0' text that the regex-based structural test matches before the real assignment — future false-pass hazard
evidence:
production.tfvars:12: # Resource sizing — pre-revenue cost cut: scale-to-zero (min_instances = 0)

tests/unit/test_concurrency.py:25-26:
def _extract_literal_int(content: str, attr: str) -> int | None:
    match = re.search(rf"{attr}\s*=\s*(\d+)\b", content)

re.search returns the first match in file order; the comment precedes the assignment line, so the extracted value comes from comment text, not config.
detail: After fixing the pinned test to assert 0, a tripwire flip-back to min_instances = 1 (assignment only) would still match the comment's 0 and falsely pass — masking the availability-critical revert.
recommended_fix: Make _extract_literal_int/_extract_literal_str ignore comment lines (filter lines starting with '#') or anchor matches to line starts, so comment text can't substitute for assignments.
